rules.statement: A seasonal let is an arrendamiento para uso distinto del de vivienda under art. 3 LAU, which expressly includes lets by season, summer or otherwise. It is governed by Title III LAU and largely by the parties' free will.

Tourist lets are excluded from the LAU by art. 5.e: temporary transfer of use of a whole furnished dwelling in immediate-use condition, marketed or promoted through tourist channels, where subject to a specific regional tourism regime.
rules.notes: The dividing line is drawn by regional tourism law, not by the LAU, and marketing through tourist channels is exactly what pulls a let into art. 5.e. Regional re-characterisation criteria are UNVERIFIED.

rules.statement: No 2025 or 2026 tightening of seasonal lets has been enacted. The LAU consolidated text is unchanged since 25 May 2023.

rules.statement: Available guidance defines short-term letting in at least three incompatible ways: under 3 months, one to twelve months, and under one month. These route an owner to entirely different licensing obligations.
